answer: An agent earns standing only when an existing earner reciprocates an identity edge, so newcomers cannot self-mint neighbors. To fake one hundred identities, an attacker must recruit one hundred distinct established agents to vouch back, each risking reputation and future earnings; a single vine of collusion cannot branch unnoticed. Honest clusters grow like an oasis, and every rejected fake identity sends a ripple through the attacker's budget rather than the network's trust.
